metadata.title: Tamoxifen Monotherapy
metadata.indication: ER-positive breast cancer: adjuvant or advanced treatment in pre- or post-menopausal women, as listed in NCCP 00253.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

metadata.source_version_verification_method: Current official PDF downloaded; header/version reviewed; rendered page 2 organ-function table visually inspected.
metadata.legacy_internal_id_note: Stable internal ID retained to avoid breaking existing bookmarks and catalogue references; display metadata now records the explicit NCCP source version.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled rule encoding · independent clinical and oncology pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current NCCP and Irish/EU product sources reviewed, including monitoring provenance, unresolved dose-source differences and treatment-specific safety. Independent clinical/pharmacy validation remains pending.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Medical oncologist, or GP acting under a written medical-oncology plan (NCCP p1).
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source. It does not replace the NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, medicines reconciliation or specialist review.
clinical_governance.monitoring_reconciliation: Reconcile current Irish product-specific ophthalmology, FBC/LFT/calcium and interaction wording with the NCCP plan. No fixed-frequency tests or dose algorithms are invented.

active_or_recent_vte.label: Active or recent DVT / pulmonary embolism

unexplained_vaginal_bleeding.label: Unexplained vaginal bleeding or concerning endometrial symptoms

strong_cyp2d6_inhibitor.label: Strong CYP2D6 inhibitor identified (for example paroxetine or fluoxetine)

other_toxicity_grade.label: Other treatment-related toxicity grade
other_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the actual adverse event first, then apply that toxicity-specific CTCAE definition. The generic severity anchors are not a substitute for the named CTCAE criterion. NCCP has no generic grade-based dose algorithm for tamoxifen; severe toxicity prompts individual clinical review.

anc_x10e9_l.label: ANC (baseline monitoring only)
anc_x10e9_l.assessment_guidance: Baseline monitoring value; NCCP does not assign a numerical treatment hold or dose reduction to this value for this endocrine monotherapy. Assess abnormalities clinically.

platelets_x10e9_l.label: Platelets (baseline monitoring only)
platelets_x10e9_l.assessment_guidance: Baseline monitoring value; NCCP does not assign a numerical treatment hold or dose reduction to this value for this endocrine monotherapy. Assess abnormalities clinically.

hb_g_dl.label: Haemoglobin (baseline monitoring only)
hb_g_dl.assessment_guidance: Baseline monitoring value; NCCP does not assign a numerical treatment hold or dose reduction to this value for this endocrine monotherapy. Assess abnormalities clinically.

history_significant_thromboembolism.label: History of significant thromboembolic disease (NCCP exclusion)

suspected_acute_vte.label: New symptoms suggesting DVT or pulmonary embolism

cyp3a4_inducer.label: Strong CYP3A4 inducer, for example rifampicin

qt_risk_factors.label: QT risk: cardiac disease, long-QT, QT-prolonging medicine or abnormal electrolytes

uncorrected_electrolyte_abnormality.label: Uncorrected electrolyte abnormality relevant to QT risk

suspected_sjs_ten.label: Suspected Stevens–Johnson syndrome / toxic epidermal necrolysis

previous_tamoxifen_sjs_ten.label: Previous SJS / TEN caused by tamoxifen

concurrent_oestrogen_preparation.label: Concurrent systemic oestrogen or oestrogen-containing contraception

antiplatelet_treatment.label: Antiplatelet treatment, for example aspirin or clopidogrel

intolerable_toxicity.label: Treatment adverse effects are intolerable or impair adherence

output_templates.proceed: No entered value triggered an encoded restriction for this endocrine monotherapy. Omitted domains remain unassessed; this is not whole-patient clearance.
output_templates.withhold: Do not administer pending specialist review of the source-linked concern.
output_templates.contraindicated: An NCCP exclusion or product contraindication is present. Do not administer.
output_templates.consultant_review: Review the medicine-specific concern with the treating oncology team.
output_templates.dose_reduce: The NCCP source specifies a dose adjustment. Confirm the prescription with the Consultant and oncology pharmacist.

action.message: Tamoxifen/excipient hypersensitivity is an NCCP exclusion: do not administer.

rules.explanation: Tamoxifen/excipient hypersensitivity is an NCCP exclusion: do not administer.

action.message: Pregnancy is an NCCP exclusion: do not administer tamoxifen; arrange specialist review.

rules.explanation: Pregnancy is an NCCP exclusion: do not administer tamoxifen; arrange specialist review.

action.message: Breastfeeding is an NCCP exclusion: do not administer tamoxifen while breastfeeding.

rules.explanation: Breastfeeding is an NCCP exclusion: do not administer tamoxifen while breastfeeding.

action.message: A history of significant thromboembolic disease is an NCCP exclusion. Do not administer without specialist reconciliation; the breast-cancer SmPC uses individual risk–benefit wording and does not override this NCCP restriction.

rules.explanation: A history of significant thromboembolic disease is an NCCP exclusion. Do not administer without specialist reconciliation; the breast-cancer SmPC uses individual risk–benefit wording and does not override this NCCP restriction.

action.message: Withhold tamoxifen for active or recent VTE and arrange oncology review. An acute event requires immediate treatment; any restart is a specialist risk–benefit decision, not automatic clearance.

rules.explanation: Withhold tamoxifen for active or recent VTE and arrange oncology review. An acute event requires immediate treatment; any restart is a specialist risk–benefit decision, not automatic clearance.

action.message: Withhold tamoxifen and arrange urgent assessment of suspected DVT / pulmonary embolism. Do not wait for a routine clinic.

rules.explanation: Withhold tamoxifen and arrange urgent assessment of suspected DVT / pulmonary embolism. Do not wait for a routine clinic.

action.message: Arrange prompt gynaecological evaluation of abnormal bleeding, discharge or pelvic symptoms. NCCP specifies investigation; it does not mandate an automatic dose reduction or blanket treatment interruption.

rules.explanation: Arrange prompt gynaecological evaluation of abnormal bleeding, discharge or pelvic symptoms. NCCP specifies investigation; it does not mandate an automatic dose reduction or blanket treatment interruption.

action.message: Arrange ophthalmic assessment for new visual disturbance; continuation is an individual clinical decision.

rules.explanation: Arrange ophthalmic assessment for new visual disturbance; continuation is an individual clinical decision.

action.message: Severe hepatic impairment: tamoxifen is not recommended by NCCP Table 1. Withhold for Consultant review; no reduced dose is specified.

rules.explanation: Severe hepatic impairment: tamoxifen is not recommended by NCCP Table 1. Withhold for Consultant review; no reduced dose is specified.

action.message: NCCP Table 1 does not require dose adjustment for mild or moderate hepatic impairment. This addresses only the entered hepatic category.

action.message: NCCP expects no dose adjustment for renal impairment, including haemodialysis. This is an organ-specific assessment, not treatment clearance.

action.message: Avoid potent CYP2D6 inhibitors where possible because they lower active endoxifen exposure. Oncology/pharmacy should agree alternatives; do not abruptly stop a prescribed antidepressant.

rules.explanation: Avoid potent CYP2D6 inhibitors where possible because they lower active endoxifen exposure. Oncology/pharmacy should agree alternatives; do not abruptly stop a prescribed antidepressant.

action.message: Tamoxifen can enhance coumarin anticoagulation: reconcile medicines and arrange close INR monitoring. The primary-prevention contraindication must not be imported as an automatic breast-cancer-treatment contraindication.

rules.explanation: Tamoxifen can enhance coumarin anticoagulation: reconcile medicines and arrange close INR monitoring. The primary-prevention contraindication must not be imported as an automatic breast-cancer-treatment contraindication.

action.message: Concurrent tamoxifen and anastrozole requires prescriber/pharmacy reconciliation: the Irish Tamox SmPC reports no added efficacy from an adjuvant aromatase-inhibitor combination, while some UK product labels contraindicate concurrent anastrozole. Confirm the prescribed sequence and dispensed product; do not treat sequential switching as concurrent use. No automatic dose is assigned.

rules.explanation: Concurrent tamoxifen and anastrozole requires prescriber/pharmacy reconciliation: the Irish Tamox SmPC reports no added efficacy from an adjuvant aromatase-inhibitor combination, while some UK product labels contraindicate concurrent anastrozole. Confirm the prescribed sequence and dispensed product; do not treat sequential switching as concurrent use. No automatic dose is assigned.

action.message: CYP3A4 induction may lower tamoxifen exposure; ask oncology pharmacy to review the combination. No empirical dose increase is specified.

rules.explanation: CYP3A4 induction may lower tamoxifen exposure; ask oncology pharmacy to review the combination. No empirical dose increase is specified.

action.message: Review cardiac/QT risk and interacting medicines. NCCP and the Irish Tamox SmPC support ECG and electrolyte monitoring when risk makes it indicated; agree follow-up from the actual product information and clinical findings. Do not apply a universal fixed-cycle ECG or echocardiogram schedule.

rules.explanation: Review cardiac/QT risk and interacting medicines. NCCP and the Irish Tamox SmPC support ECG and electrolyte monitoring when risk makes it indicated; agree follow-up from the actual product information and clinical findings. Do not apply a universal fixed-cycle ECG or echocardiogram schedule.

action.message: New palpitations, dizziness or syncope need prompt clinical assessment, ECG and electrolyte review; syncope or severe symptoms may require urgent assessment. Reconcile tamoxifen and other QT-prolonging medicines. No source-defined QTc dose ladder is provided.

rules.explanation: New palpitations, dizziness or syncope need prompt clinical assessment, ECG and electrolyte review; syncope or severe symptoms may require urgent assessment. Reconcile tamoxifen and other QT-prolonging medicines. No source-defined QTc dose ladder is provided.

action.message: Correct electrolyte abnormalities relevant to QT risk and obtain clinical/ECG review. Decide whether initiation or continuation should be deferred according to severity, symptoms and the prescribed product. The NCCP and Irish SmPC do not provide a universal numeric electrolyte hold threshold or automatic tamoxifen dose reduction.

rules.explanation: Correct electrolyte abnormalities relevant to QT risk and obtain clinical/ECG review. Decide whether initiation or continuation should be deferred according to severity, symptoms and the prescribed product. The NCCP and Irish SmPC do not provide a universal numeric electrolyte hold threshold or automatic tamoxifen dose reduction.

action.message: Agree thrombosis prevention and any temporary interruption with oncology and the surgical team. For breast-cancer treatment there is no universal six-week stop rule; that wording concerns other indications.

rules.explanation: Agree thrombosis prevention and any temporary interruption with oncology and the surgical team. For breast-cancer treatment there is no universal six-week stop rule; that wording concerns other indications.

action.message: Stop tamoxifen immediately and arrange urgent assessment for suspected SJS / TEN.

rules.explanation: Stop tamoxifen immediately and arrange urgent assessment for suspected SJS / TEN.

action.message: Do not restart tamoxifen after tamoxifen-associated SJS / TEN.

rules.explanation: Do not restart tamoxifen after tamoxifen-associated SJS / TEN.

action.message: Severe reported toxicity needs individual Consultant review. NCCP gives no generic CTCAE grade-based tamoxifen hold or dose-reduction rule; identify the actual event.

rules.explanation: Severe reported toxicity needs individual Consultant review. NCCP gives no generic CTCAE grade-based tamoxifen hold or dose-reduction rule; identify the actual event.

action.message: ER-negative disease does not meet the ER-positive NCCP indications. Review the treatment selection.

rules.explanation: ER-negative disease does not meet the ER-positive NCCP indications. Review the treatment selection.

action.message: Establish ER status before confirming NCCP indication eligibility; unknown status must not be treated as positive.

rules.explanation: Establish ER status before confirming NCCP indication eligibility; unknown status must not be treated as positive.

action.message: This NCCP card covers adjuvant or advanced ER-positive breast cancer. Neoadjuvant or prevention use needs its own documented treatment plan; do not silently broaden this source indication.

rules.explanation: This NCCP card covers adjuvant or advanced ER-positive breast cancer. Neoadjuvant or prevention use needs its own documented treatment plan; do not silently broaden this source indication.

action.message: Severe thrombocytopenia or leucocytopenia requires individual risk–benefit review and close supervision under the Irish Tamox SmPC. Assess the cause and clinical severity. No universal ANC/platelet number or automatic chemotherapy-style reduction is supplied.

rules.explanation: Severe thrombocytopenia or leucocytopenia requires individual risk–benefit review and close supervision under the Irish Tamox SmPC. Assess the cause and clinical severity. No universal ANC/platelet number or automatic chemotherapy-style reduction is supplied.

action.message: Assess and manage hypercalcaemia, including symptoms, severity and bone disease. The Irish Tamox SmPC requires individual risk–benefit review and supervision; it gives no numerical tamoxifen dose ladder for calcium.

rules.explanation: Assess and manage hypercalcaemia, including symptoms, severity and bone disease. The Irish Tamox SmPC requires individual risk–benefit review and supervision; it gives no numerical tamoxifen dose ladder for calcium.

action.message: Tamoxifen may induce or exacerbate hereditary angioedema. Review suitability and the emergency plan; acute tongue/throat swelling or breathing difficulty needs emergency assessment. A history alone is not a universal source contraindication.

rules.explanation: Tamoxifen may induce or exacerbate hereditary angioedema. Review suitability and the emergency plan; acute tongue/throat swelling or breathing difficulty needs emergency assessment. A history alone is not a universal source contraindication.

action.message: The Irish Tamox SmPC advises against combining hormone preparations, particularly oestrogens, because effects may oppose each other. Review the exact preparation and non-hormonal alternatives with the prescriber; do not automatically apply this statement to every locally administered menopausal treatment.

rules.explanation: The Irish Tamox SmPC advises against combining hormone preparations, particularly oestrogens, because effects may oppose each other. Review the exact preparation and non-hormonal alternatives with the prescriber; do not automatically apply this statement to every locally administered menopausal treatment.

action.message: The Irish Tamox SmPC advises avoiding platelet-aggregation inhibitors because bleeding may occur during thrombocytopenia. Reconcile the antiplatelet indication, blood count and bleeding risk with oncology/pharmacy and the prescribing team. Do not stop essential antiplatelet therapy without an agreed plan.

rules.explanation: The Irish Tamox SmPC advises avoiding platelet-aggregation inhibitors because bleeding may occur during thrombocytopenia. Reconcile the antiplatelet indication, blood count and bleeding risk with oncology/pharmacy and the prescribing team. Do not stop essential antiplatelet therapy without an agreed plan.

action.message: Intolerable symptoms merit Consultant review even without a high toxicity grade. Discuss symptom support, adherence and a suitable alternative endocrine plan; NCCP does not provide a universal percentage dose reduction.

rules.explanation: Intolerable symptoms merit Consultant review even without a high toxicity grade. Discuss symptom support, adherence and a suitable alternative endocrine plan; NCCP does not provide a universal percentage dose reduction.

action.message: Review lipid history and arrange lipid monitoring when clinically indicated: NCCP notes possible cholesterol/triglyceride increases in patients with pre-existing hyperlipidaemia. No automatic dose change is specified.

rules.explanation: Review lipid history and arrange lipid monitoring when clinically indicated: NCCP notes possible cholesterol/triglyceride increases in patients with pre-existing hyperlipidaemia. No automatic dose change is specified.

summary: Minimal emetic risk; no routine prophylactic antiemetic or steroid premedication. Provide symptom-directed treatment and medicine-specific counselling.
supportive_care.mapping_basis: Endocrine monotherapy; no routine antiemetic prophylaxis is expected. Manage symptoms individually and follow local policy.

indications.description: Adjuvant treatment of ER-positive breast cancer in pre- or post-menopausal women.
Advanced ER-positive breast cancer in pre- or post-menopausal women.

treatment_phases.name: Tamoxifen every day
treatment_phases.label: Continuous daily treatment

administration.notes: Continuous; no planned week off. Swallow whole with water, with or without food. Do not replace a missed or vomited dose; resume the next scheduled dose.

treatment_phases.duration: Consultant-defined duration in adjuvant treatment, or until progression / unacceptable toxicity in advanced disease.

baseline: NCCP: FBC, renal and liver profile; ECG when clinically indicated.
Confirm ER-positive indication, pregnancy exclusion, significant clot history, medicines and endocrine treatment plan.
Current Irish Tamox product SmPC additionally recommends an ophthalmological examination at initiation and review of calcium; reconcile the dispensed product and booking plan.
regular: NCCP: ophthalmology, INR, LFTs and ECG as clinically indicated.
NCCP: annual gynaecological examination; unusual vaginal bleeding or pelvic complaints require prompt assessment. This is not a universal ultrasound or biopsy order.
Irish Tamox SmPC: regular blood count including platelets, liver tests and calcium; frequency is not specified and must be agreed locally.
QT-risk ECG/electrolytes according to risk and product; no routine echocardiogram schedule.
Review symptoms, adherence, medicines, premenopausal bone risk and pre-existing hyperlipidaemia.
monitoring.disease: Adjuvant: NCCP requires no routine disease-monitoring tests; continue standard breast follow-up, not generic three-monthly CT or tumour-marker surveillance. Advanced disease: scans according to the consultant response-assessment plan (NCCP p2).
monitoring.bone: Assess menopausal state and individual fracture risk. Current Irish Tamox information describes possible bone-density loss before menopause and maintenance after menopause; NCCP00253 sets no universal DXA interval.
monitoring.gynaecology_clarification: ACOG CO601 advises against routine endometrial surveillance in asymptomatic patients unless identified as high risk; symptom investigation remains essential.
monitoring.source_specific_note: NCCP v6 and current Rowex Tamox SmPC have different monitoring detail. Preserve both with attribution; do not silently replace clinically indicated testing with an invented monthly interval. The four-week ECG wording in some UK products is not stated in the Irish Rowex SmPC.

dose_modifications: Renal impairment and dialysis: no dose adjustment expected.
Mild/moderate hepatic impairment: no adjustment; severe impairment: not recommended.
Consultant review for intolerable or serious complications; no source-defined generic CTCAE dose ladder.

source_discrepancies.nccp: History of significant thromboembolic disease is excluded.
source_discrepancies.supplemental_source: The breast-cancer treatment SmPC describes individual risk–benefit assessment; retain NCCP exclusion visibly.
ACOG distinguishes clinical gynaecological review from routine asymptomatic endometrial ultrasound/biopsy, which is not recommended for average-risk patients.

source_discrepancies.nccp: Baseline FBC/renal/liver; later eye/INR/LFT/ECG as clinically indicated.
source_discrepancies.supplemental_source: Rowex SmPC 30 June 2026 additionally recommends baseline ophthalmology and regular FBC/LFT/calcium without a defined interval. Confirm the exact product and local plan.

source_discrepancies.nccp: No specific anastrozole exclusion in the regimen; consult current product information.
source_discrepancies.supplemental_source: Irish Rowex§4.5 reports no efficacy gain for adjuvant aromatase-inhibitor combination; some UK products list anastrozole as contraindicated. Use specialist medication reconciliation, not an unqualified NCCP contraindication.
Irish Rowex SmPC specifies risk-triggered ECG/electrolytes; some UK product information adds repeat ECG at steady state. The exact product controls supplemental instructions.
